name: Web Popups
author: etidona
description: Open any web app (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Proton Mail or any other site) in a popup next to the bar, one button per app, with unread badges, notifications and a separate login for each app. Pages are rendered by Qt WebEngine in a Python helper process that keeps running in the background while the plugin is enabled; logins and site data are stored in ~/.local/share/webpopups.
